    org.apache.cayenne.access.types.LocalDateTimeValueType
    no longer registered by default. Replaced by LocalDateTimeType, which reads and writes the value directly via JDBC without a java.sql intermediary and the JVM time zone conversion that comes with it.
    org.apache.cayenne.access.types.LocalDateValueType
    no longer registered by default. Replaced by LocalDateType, which reads and writes the value directly via JDBC without a java.sql intermediary and the JVM time zone conversion that comes with it.
    org.apache.cayenne.access.types.LocalTimeValueType
    no longer registered by default. Replaced by LocalTimeType, which reads and writes the value directly via JDBC without a java.sql intermediary and the JVM time zone conversion that comes with it.
    org.apache.cayenne.access.types.UUIDValueType
    no longer registered by default. Replaced by UUIDType, which stores the value in a binary column when the mapped JDBC type is binary, instead of always converting it to a 36-char string.
